mapper.select: SELECT * FROM api_test_envs ORDER BY FIELD(environment, 'TEST', 'PROD'), environment
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_test_envs (environment, name, base_url, default_headers, default_token, db_host, db_port, db_name, db_user, db_password, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{environment}, #{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{defaultHeaders}, #{defaultToken}, #{dbHost}, #{dbPort}, #{dbName}, #{dbUser}, #{dbPassword}, #{enabled}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), base_url = VALUES(base_url), default_headers = VALUES(default_headers), default_token = VALUES(default_token), db_host = VALUES(db_host), db_port = VALUES(db_port), db_name = VALUES(db_name), db_user = VALUES(db_user), db_password = VALUES(db_password), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
